# Fallout 76: The PITT patch notes - September 13, 2022 (Patch 38)

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_72_nukaknights-post-patchnotes38.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

Today our latest update for Fallout 76 launches and brings the Expeditions system into the game: For the first time, you will cross the borders of Appalachia to complete missions in The Pitt. The update also starts Fallout 76 Season 10, of course with a wealth of fresh rank rewards. And of course you can expect lots of gameplay improvements and bug fixes.

### UPDATE HIGHLIGHTS

**Responder Renaissance:** Head to the Whitespring Refuge at Whitespring Resort to meet a new generation of Responders. They are working hard to support those in need - whether at home in Appalachia or, using their Vertibirds, in remote settlements.
**Charge & Fly:** But even the responders can use a helping hand. Complete new daily quests in Whitespring Refuge to gain their trust and recharge the Vertibird's Ultracite battery.
**Off to The Pitt:** Launch the Vertibird and use it to lead expeditions to The Pitt, where you can tackle our first two missions: Union Dues and Fire from the Ashes. Put your firepower at the service of the busy union and fight against the insidious raider fanatics.
**Earn Stamps & Rewards:** Complete missions in The Pitt to get legendary weapons and armor, legendary modules, in-game currency, and more. You will also receive stamps based on your performance, which you can use to purchase special rewards in the Whitespring Refuge.
**Visit the City of Steel in Season 10!** Earn S.C.O.R.E. and rise through the ranks to earn a range of new rewards, including the Auto Ax and Union Power Armor, on the Fallout 76 Season 10 board called "Red Rocket in America Presents: 'The City of Steel'."
### UPDATE VERSION 1.7.0.23

Here you can find out the download size of today's patch on the respective platform:

**Xbox:** 80.8GB
### INTRODUCING EXPEDITIONS & THE PITT

We're adding the Expeditions system to Fallout 76, taking you and up to three other players beyond the borders of Appalachia for the first time, where you'll take on challenging and repeatable missions. Although anyone can join the expeditions, our recommended level for the best gaming experience is 50+.

##### THE RESPONDERS ARE BACK!

More and more people are returning to Appalachia, including some who have heard of the responders of yesteryear and now want to continue their work helping those in need. This new generation of responders has set up their base of operations at the Whitespring Resort and calls it the “Whitespring Refuge.”

- Responders recently found an old Vertibird and made it operational again. With your help, they want to expand their efforts to more distant settlements in the wasteland.

- Visit the Whitespring Refuge to start the “Responder Renaissance” quest, where you will meet many noble souls of the new Responders.
- Gradually you will learn more about the Responders' goals, gain their trust, and eventually gain access to the expeditions you lead using your Vertibird.
##### CHARGE & FLY

- To go on an expedition, you must first “refuel” the Vertibird by recharging its Ultracite battery cell (ultra cell). However, ultracell charges are a rare commodity and the responders have to manage them themselves.
